name: Diner — Submit order to table session tab
description: A diner reviews cart items, submits an order to the table session without logging in, and views the live order confirmation status.

planSteps.description: Add an item to the cart
Click the View Cart button to open the order summary drawer
Click Submit Order to send the order to the counter
Verify the order status screen appears showing Status: Incoming, Table Number, and the list of ordered items with prices
